sections.title: THE GAME
sections.content: **Space Age Racer** is a racing game inspired by the podracers from Star Wars. You take on rival pods across deserts, forests and frozen bases. I made it for fun, to race with my friends while learning more about Unity and Arduino.

sections.title: THE CONTROLLER
sections.content: The idea was a **homemade arcade game**, played on [a controller](media:-2) I built out of wood. Each lever of the controller drives one engine: give one more power than the other and the pod turns. A button on the right handle adds a boost.

sections.title: DESIGN CHALLENGES
sections.content: I developed **the whole game in Unity**. The real challenge was making the levers feel natural to drive, which meant reworking almost everything, again and again. I also built several prototype tracks to test different ideas, with my friends as playtesters. Little by little, racing started to feel fun.
